gameness.definition: gameness = the quality that makes interaction feel like play

etymology.game: Old English gamen — joy, fun, amusement. Proto-Germanic *gamanan — participation.
etymology.gameness: the QUALITY of being game. willingness to engage. courage to play.

components.agency: the player's choices matter (farm: plant what YOU want)
components.feedback: actions produce visible results (plant grows, primal appears)
components.discovery: surprise and delight (new recipe, rare primal, hidden combo)
components.progression: growth over time (more primals, better crops, unlocked recipes)
components.challenge: difficulty that respects the player (catch rates, grow times, recipe complexity)
components.social: sharing and showing (minted items, primal collection, farm layout)

gameness.compile_always: COMPILE ALWAYS is the gameness engine. it never stops computing. every visitor interaction = input. every page view = a move. the compiler takes the move, ferments it, and produces the next state. the game is ALWAYS being compiled. there is no idle state for #1. #2-4 idle and judge. #1 compiles and builds.
